QuestInfo.name: When I Call Your Name
QuestInfo.0:
The Forest Master gave you a quiet, thoughtful look.
Wondering what she had to say, you approached her.

She wanted to see your face up close.
QuestInfo.1:
Is the Forest Master disappointed that you don't remember her? If so, she hasn't shown it. She told you that your being there was enough. 

You asked her if you really are the Forest Master, destined to help her circulate her power through the woodlands.
QuestInfo.2:
You're still confused about many things, but will gladly help if you can.
In gratitude for your commitment, the Forest Master gave you the #bLeaf Emblem#k, the embodiment of the forest's energy. 

The task of awakening as the Forest Child is both very simple and very difficult.
You must remember the names of your Spirit Guides, by reconnecting with your past lives.

With the Leaf Emblem in hand, you promised to see the task through.
